module: Conductor of the drift gameplay. Keeps the current context (inFreeroam, inChallenge, inFreeroamChallenge, inAnotherMissionType, inFreeroamCruising, inSplitscreen), the challenge mode (None, A to B, A to B with stunt zones, Gymkhana, Competition), the pause/freeze states and the debug flag. On every context or mode change, it loads or unloads the other gameplay_drift_* extensions according to the variableExtensions table. A modder uses it to read the drift context or change it, and to reset the whole system.
notes: Extensions loaded per context: stuntZones (inChallenge), display (inChallenge, inFreeroamChallenge, inFreeroamCruising, inSplitscreen), quickMessages (inFreeroam, inChallenge, inFreeroamChallenge, inFreeroamCruising), bounds (inChallenge, inFreeroamChallenge), freeroam_driftSpots (inFreeroam, inFreeroamChallenge, inFreeroamCruising), scoreboard (inChallenge); per challenge mode: stallingSystem (Gymkhana), destination (A to B, A to B with stunt zones, with the inFreeroamChallenge context).

Manual loading: freeroam_cruising (loaded only outside career, outside multiseat, if the enableDriftFreeroamCruising setting is active, outside the freeroam tutorial and outside first drive), sounds (loaded as long as gameplay_drift_display exists) and multiplayer (loaded via onMPSessionChanged).

setContext always emits the onDriftContextChanged(context, oldContext) hook, even if the context does not change; the extensions are only reloaded if the context actually changed. Switching to inFreeroam forces the challenge mode to "None".
The freeze (frozen) is true if the player is out of bounds, going the wrong way or in the concluding phase of a drift spot; it is recomputed every frame and set back to false by reset/clear.
pause (paused) is used to suspend the drift systems during the end screen of mission challenges.
getMultiplayerEnabled returns a session object or nil/false (not a strict boolean): true only if a multiplayer session exists.
In checkLoadedExtensions, the local variable driftDebugInfo shadows the module's; and the call ext:getDriftDebugInfo() passes ext as the self argument to a function that does not need it (harmless).

clear.desc: Calls reset() of all the loaded drift extensions (except general), sets frozen back to false then empties the cascade zones (gameplay_drift_stuntZones.clear).

reset.desc: Calls reset() of all the loaded drift extensions (except general), sets frozen back to false then resets the cascade zones (gameplay_drift_stuntZones.reset).

setChallengeMode.desc: Changes the challenge mode and loads/unloads the extensions concerned. No effect if the mode is identical.

newChallengeMode.desc: "None", "A to B", "A to B with stunt zones", "Gymkhana" or "Competition".

returns.desc: Challenge mode, nil as long as it has never been set.

setContext.desc: Changes the drift context, emits onDriftContextChanged(newContext, oldContext) and updates the loaded extensions.

setPaused.desc: Pauses the drift system (or resumes it).

getPaused.desc: Indicates whether the drift system is paused.

getFrozen.desc: Indicates whether drift scoring and detection are frozen (out of bounds, wrong way, concluding phase).

setDebug.desc: Enables/disables drift debug mode (imgui window "Drift general") and emits onDriftDebugChanged(value).

getGeneralDebug.desc: Indicates whether general debug is active.

getExtensionDebug.desc: Indicates whether debug is enabled for a given drift extension (general debug active, extension known, checkbox ticked).

returns.desc: true if debug of this extension is active.

getDriftDebugInfo.desc: Returns {default=true, canBeChanged=false} for the drift debug window.

getMultiplayerEnabled.desc: Returns a truthy value only if a multiplayer session is in progress and multiplayer drift is allowed.

returns.desc: True/false value (can be nil or a boolean).

onAnyMissionChanged.desc: Hook: called when a mission starts or stops. Does clear(); when a non-drift mission starts switches to "inAnotherMissionType"; when it stops sets pause/freeze back to false and the context to "inFreeroam".

onClientEndMission.desc: Hook: level end, puts the context back to "inFreeroam".

onClientPostStartMission.desc: Hook: called when the level is loaded; if no mission is in the foreground, switches to "inFreeroam" and does reset().

onDeserialized.desc: Hook: restores debugFlag, context and challengeMode after a Lua reload.

onSerialize.desc: Hook: saves debugFlag, context and challengeMode before a Lua reload.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook: lists the lua files of /lua/ge/extensions/gameplay/drift for the tracking of extensions and debug.

onMPSessionChanged.desc: Hook: loads gameplay_drift_multiplayer when entering a multiplayer session and unloads it when leaving.

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame: debug window, loading/unloading of the sounds and cruising, recomputation of the frozen state.

onVehicleResetted.desc: Hook: if the vehicle put back in place is tracked by gameplay_drift_drift, emits onDriftPlVehReset(vid).
